Full silhouettes entirely inside their own equal square cell with 12% padding; no overlap or particles crossing cells. Rich sculpted 3D forms, appealing facial acting, not flat icons.
Columns left to right: 1 deep-blue Neptune planet with white cloud streaks and a windswept scarf; 2 violet spiral Galaxy character with warm glowing centre and friendly face, spiral arms retained; 3 pearl-grey cratered Moon with sleepy cap and gentle smile; 4 warm gold Star with five softly rounded rays and curious eyes. Galaxy must be a spiral not a planet. All distinct silhouettes.
